title: Collateral Protection Insurance — Premium Billing and Refund Terms by Plan
content:
Collateral Protection Insurance premium is billed, earned and refunded on the same terms in every plan, CollateralGuard Plan A through CollateralGuard Plan F. The monthly premium itself differs by plan and is set in the plan schedule.

| Term | CollateralGuard Plans A, B, C, D, E and F |
|---|---|
| Billing cadence of placed coverage | monthly, in advance |
| How premium is earned within a billing period | daily, pro rata by actual days |
| Whether the first billing period is prorated | yes: the first period, starting on the coverage effective date and ending the day before the next placement-day anniversary, is prorated by actual days at the monthly premium multiplied by 12 and divided by 365 per day |
| Rounding of every prorated premium and refund | half-up to the cent |
| Contract statuses during which no premium is billed | repossessed, charged off, paid off, liquidated, unwound |
| Whether a premium added to the contract balance accrues contract interest | yes |
| Whether every premium is refunded when accepted proof shows coverage effective on or before the coverage effective date of the placed coverage | yes |
| Refund basis when accepted proof starts after the placed coverage's effective date | pro rata by day from the proof's policy effective date |
| Refund basis for unearned premium when the record closes with the contract | pro rata by day from the closure date |
| Calendar days after the triggering acceptance or closure within which the refund is issued | 15 |
| Smallest refund mailed by check (smaller residual refunds to a borrower with no open balance are not mailed) | USD 1.00 |
| Where a refund goes, first applicable wins | credited to the contract balance; then credited to the deficiency balance; then mailed to the borrower |

## Notes on the terms

- Half-up rounding to the cent takes a computed USD 12.345 to USD 12.35 and USD 12.344 to USD 12.34.
- The smallest-check figure compares the refund amount with USD 1.00: a hypothetical mailed refund of USD 0.99 is not mailed, and one of USD 1.00 is.
- The destination list is read in order and the first destination that applies receives the refund.
